DOC-0045 2026-09-09
MEETING NOTES — Preparing the BETA Audit Follow-Up
Folder
Date: 2026-09-09
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
Attendees: PERSON-0014 for TEAM-0002; audit records clerk;
program queue chair; station calendar coordinator.
Purpose: Prepare the follow-up folder for the records audit
week held from 2026-08-24 through 2026-08-28. ISSUE-0139 and
TASK-0370 locate the hydraulics example used to explain the
folder.
Decisions Keep the priority-change hold register with its
original submission dates. Add each later review appointment
beside the proposal instead of moving the proposal into a new
sheet without its earlier context. The freeze concerned
changes to existing priority fields; initial intake still
required a priority and written reason.
The follow-up meeting will take place on 2026-09-14 at 10:50.
Its folder needs the proposal question, submitting role,
review appointment, and any clarification requested by the
chair. The meeting will examine the paper trail without
presenting workload figures or record-category snapshots.
Separate calendar corrections from the merits of a priority
proposal. A late appointment requires an explanation of the
schedule change, while the proposal still needs its own
justification.
Action items
_— owner: Audit records clerk. Due: 2026-09-11. Arrange the
dated hold-register papers for the meeting.
